files.README.md:
# Colderbridge Architects - QA handbook

Office-wide quality assurance handbook. The handbook consists of exactly the files listed in qa/index.txt; anything not covered there goes to the partners for a written ruling.
files.qa/structural-qa.md:
# Structural QA

(2026-02 revision)

## Foundation pour inspection

Every foundation pour is inspected before backfill; the inspection sheet is countersigned by the site lead.

## Professional indemnity

Professional indemnity cover is renewed each April; certificates are filed with the office manager.

## Rebar tolerances

Rebar spacing is checked against the drawing set before the pour is signed off.
files.qa/site-records.md:
# Site records

## Photograph log

Progress photographs are filed weekly, named by plot and date.

## Handover pack

The handover pack collects warranties, as-built drawings and the snag list.
